Unlike CNNs, which rely on local connectivity and shared weights, capsules aim to capture more complex patterns and maintain spatial hierarchies.

Capsules can be arranged in layers, with higher-level capsules aggregating information from lower-level capsules to form more abstract representations. Connections between capsules are learned during training, allowing the network to learn how different features relate to one another in a scene.
